name: Move homework-OCR consent gating behind deterministic request validation
description: Root cause verified on origin/main 08d75f4: POST /homework/ocr asserts LLM consent before deterministic multipart validation, although only an accepted JPEG/PNG/WebP within the upload limits can reach the OCR provider. Withdrawn consent therefore masks established 400/413 validation outcomes.
acceptanceCriteria:
Definition of done (source baseline: origin/main 08d75f4):

1. Consent ordering and externally visible variants
- An oversized declared Content-Length still returns the existing 413 even when LLM consent is withdrawn; the body and OCR provider are not processed.
- Missing/non-file image input, unsupported MIME type, and a file over MAX_IMAGE_BYTES still return their existing 400 responses even when consent is withdrawn; no OCR/LLM provider dispatch occurs.
- A valid JPEG, PNG, or WebP within the existing size limits that would reach provider.extractText returns the existing consent-denied 403 when consent is withdrawn, before provider construction or dispatch.
- With active consent, accepted input still reaches the selected OCR provider exactly once and preserves the existing response schema and validation limits.

2. Boundary coverage
- Update apps/api/src/middleware/metering.coverage.manifest.ts and apps/api/src/middleware/metering.coverage.guard.test.ts so the final homework-OCR consent owner and ordering are structurally represented; the guard must fail if this LLM path becomes unclassified or can dispatch without a consent boundary. OCR metering remains route-owned and unchanged.

3. Regression proof
- Add focused regression cases in apps/api/src/routes/homework.test.ts for withdrawn-consent Content-Length 413, each withdrawn-consent multipart/file-validation 400 branch, and withdrawn-consent valid-file 403/no-provider-call. The regression test must fail against the production implementation with the fix reverted and pass with the fix present.
- Execute and record the focused red -> green -> production-revert red -> exact-restore green sequence with: DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5432/mentomate_test pnpm exec jest --config apps/api/jest.config.cjs --runInBand --silent apps/api/src/routes/homework.test.ts apps/api/src/middleware/metering.coverage.guard.test.ts
- Run routed validation with: DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5432/mentomate_test bash scripts/check-change-class.sh --run --fast

4. Scope and authority
- Expected collision set: apps/api/src/routes/homework.ts, apps/api/src/routes/homework.test.ts, apps/api/src/middleware/metering.coverage.manifest.ts, and apps/api/src/middleware/metering.coverage.guard.test.ts; touch OCR service/test files only if the selected boundary placement requires them.
- Preserve the accepted MIME set, exact byte limits, Content-Length behavior, chunked-upload limitation, provider selection/configuration, response schema, and metering. No schema, migration, upload-policy, prompt/model/provider-routing, or unrelated consent-policy change is authorized. If one becomes necessary, stop and obtain a separate ruling/item.
- Acceptance requires an exact-head strict-green Adversarial review because this is a P1 consent/security boundary change.
riskImpact: P1 privacy/control-order defect at the OCR LLM boundary. Incorrect placement can either dispatch after withdrawal or alter established upload validation, body-processing, and provider-construction behavior. The repair is bounded to one route flow plus structural coverage; no schema or upload-policy change is required.
